title: Microsoft Edge: v.154 - Sign in to Edge with a Google account
description: Users can now sign in to Microsoft Edge using a Google account in addition to the Microsoft account from the profile menu and Edge sign-in screen. Available for Windows and macOS devices.  Admins can control availability to this feature using the NonMicrosoftAccountSignInEnabled policy.
